ui.title: # Awesome Game Assets
ui.intro: A curated directory of game assets and tools with license notes, including restricted licenses: 3D models, sprites, textures, sound effects, VFX, ability / casting demos, animation and editors. Every entry lists its URL, a license we checked on the source page, and what it is good for.
ui.warn_line: > ⚠️ Repositories we found that look like piracy, cracks, paid-asset redistribution, star farming or malware are listed separately in [WARNING.md](WARNING.md) so you can avoid them. Do not use them.
rules: Only sources whose license is stated clearly on the project or its official site. Per-asset licenses are marked as such; check each asset before use.
No pirated, cracked or star-farmed repositories (stars, forks and activity are checked), and no archived or unusable ones.
Automated checks report broken links and bot-blocked or timed-out sources; a warning is not proof that a source is reachable.
Licenses were checked on {date} via the GitHub API `license` field or the official license page linked in each row.

Preview images are linked from the original project and credited. Display here does not grant reuse rights: check the linked asset terms. The hero/category art is generated; missing original previews are labelled, never replaced with invented results.
ui.credits: Some entries were found through these lists. We only took the pointers: every source was re-checked (license, reachability) and every description was rewritten for this list, nothing was copied wholesale. Entries found this way say *listed in* with a link to the list.
ui.contrib:
## Contributing

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md). Edit `data/entries.json`, then run `python3 tools/render_readme.py` and `python3 tools/verify.py`.
